title: subscribe_events does not validate Content-Type: text/event-stream
description: subscribe_events sends Accept: text/event-stream but does not verify the response Content-Type header. A misconfigured server returning 200 application/json causes the client to silently yield no frames (no delimiter found) or Unknown frames for embedded newlines. Caller has no way to distinguish a silent misconfiguration from a stream with no events. Fix: check resp.headers() for text/event-stream before starting the stream; return ClientError::InvalidSession on mismatch.
